name: Weekly RS Trend Following with EMA Alignment [Opt-v2 SL=3%]

entry_rules.conditions: ema_8 > ema_21 AND rsi_14 > 50 AND mrs_daily_index > 0 AND mrs_weekly_index > 0 AND r.regime_code IN ('PRESS_GAS', 'HALF_SIZE')

exit_rules.conditions: close < ema_21 OR r.regime_code = 'STEP_ASIDE' OR mrs_daily_index < 0

name: Volatility Expansion with Market Regime Alignment [Opt-v3 SL=3%]
